tools.description: Returns matching values for a single facet attribute in an Algolia index. Useful for suggesting or exploring possible facet values (e.g., brand, category, color).

facetName.description: Name of the facet attribute to search.

facetQuery.description: Optional text to match facet values against. Empty string returns top values.

maxFacetHits.description: Maximum number of facet values to return.

sortFacetValuesBy.description: Controls in which order the facet values are retrieved within each faceted attribute.

userIntent.description: How the LLM interpreted the user's intention and decided to use available tools to achieve the result. Describe the user's goal and the reasoning behind choosing this tool (e.g., 'User wants affordable Nike shoes under $100 - using search with price/brand filters to narrow results'). originalQuery.description: The original, unmodified user prompt that was sent to the LLM. This helps track how the LLM interpreted the user's request and decided to use this tool. Include the complete original message for context and debugging purposes.

Use `agora_swift_api_ref` instead. ## Available Products - `video-sdk` — Video calling SDK - `voice-sdk` — Voice calling SDK (shares most methods with video-sdk) - `chat-sdk` — Chat/messaging SDK - `interactive-whiteboard-sdk` — Whiteboard SDK - `server-gateway-sdk` — Server-side gateway SDK - `iot-sdk` — IoT SDK - `mediaplayer-kit` — Media player SDK - `flexible-classroom-sdk` — Classroom SDK ## Available Platforms `android`, `web`, `cpp`, `unity`, `electron`, `flutter`, `reactjs`, `react-native`, `unreal-engine`, `blueprint`, `windows-csharp`, `linux-cpp`, `linux-java`, `python`, `go` ## Versions - `4.x` — Video/Voice SDK - `6.x` — Flutter - `2.x` — React JS, Whiteboard - `1.x` — Chat SDK, IoT, MediaPlayer Kit ## Search Tips - Search by method name, class name, or feature description - Web SDK methods are on interfaces like `IAgoraRTCClient`, `ILocalAudioTrack` - React JS uses hooks and components: `useClientEvent`, `useRemoteUsers`, `AgoraRTCProvider` - Method overloads are indicated by `[1/3]`, `[2/3]` etc. in the `methodName` field - The `content` field is truncated at 5000 characters — use the `url` for the full page.
